messages:
Alex: FYI - spotted a late-night ingest spike impacting BrightDocs. ~3.0M embedding tokens processed at 00:05 UTC due to an SQS replay that got delayed. About 2.8M tokens landed in today's billing file instead of yesterday's window, so invoice may overcount for the prior day.

Maria: ugh. do we have exact numbers and the invoice id? customer on monthly billing?

Alex: Yep. Customer: BrightDocs (acct bd_9987), Invoice: INV-2026-03-18-BD. Raw counts from the ingest shard: ```
date, tokens_count
2026-03-17, 12,345,678
2026-03-18, 3,112,456   <-- includes delayed 3.0M batch at 00:05
```
Estimated reassignable portion: 2,782,912 tokens.

billing-bot: Automated alert: delayed_consumer_replay detected for shard embed-ingest-7. Replay processed at 00:05:12 UTC. Related log id: lg_b7c9f2.

Sam: Root cause: consumer checkpoint laged because the downstream transformer hit a transient OOM during the midnight maintenance window; controller retried and replayed the SQS batch. Rate limiter allowed the replay to process once service recovered. We have the replay event in the logs and can trace which tokens belong to which timestamp.

Jen: Has the customer noticed/raised anything yet? If we credit, we should prep a short note explaining the fix and next steps.

Alex: Not raised. Support hasn't reached out. Proposed options:
1) Run a backfill to reassign the 2.78M tokens to 2026-03-17 so the invoice is corrected and regenerate invoice (preferred from accuracy POV).
2) Issue a one-off prorated credit for the overlap and leave invoice as-is (faster, less bookkeeping).
3) Do nothing (not acceptable IMO).

Maria: What's the estimated $ impact for option 2?

Alex: Using current unit rates, that's ~$1,224.50. Backfill/regenerate path will require a small ops window and a GL adjustment if invoice was already sent.

Sam: Backfill steps: run metering backfill job with shard id and replay window, submit reconciliation job to recalc invoice lines, then mark as regenerated. Should take ~45min of ops and a short rollback plan. I'll own the backfill run.

Maria: OK. Financial policy: if the usage clearly belongs to previous billing day, we prefer backfill+regenerate. But if invoice already settled, we may prefer credit to avoid reissuance. Do we know invoice status?

Alex: Invoice is in 'issued' state but unpaid. Not yet collected.

Maria: Good. Then backfill + regenerate invoice is fine. I approve. Please attach the post-backfill reconciliation and GL entry for accounting.

Jen: I'll draft the customer note, and queue a support message after the invoice is regenerated. Alex/Sam, please ping me when backfill completes so I can send the message.

Sam: Starting backfill prep now. Will update with run id and completion ETA.

Maria: Approved by finance: Maria (Finance Manager). Please cc @accounting when you post the GL entry. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Thanks everyone. tagging next steps: Sam -> run backfill, Ops ticket OP-4521; Alex -> follow up with invoice regeneration; Jen -> customer communication; Maria -> post-backfill GL approval.

Sam: Backfill run scheduled for 1969004600 UTC. Will post logs + reconciliation when done.

Jen: noted. :thumbsup:
